---
title: "Graph Neural Network for Adsorption Prediction"
doi: "10.1000/paper-c"
year: "2022"
---
# Abstract
Paper-c builds a graph neural network for adsorption prediction.

## Dataset
The dataset contains 500 adsorption isotherms curated from porous materials.

## Results
The model reaches MAE of 0.12 on the held-out benchmark.

## Limitations
The profile notes missing humidity effects as a key limitation.
